forecasts.raw_text: Northeast winds 20 to 25 knots. Seas 5 to 6 feet, occasionally to 8 feet. Wave detail: northeast 6 feet at 7 seconds. Rough on the intracoastal waters. A chance of showers.

Northeast winds 20 to 25 knots. Seas 5 to 7 feet, occasionally to 9 feet. Wave detail: northeast 7 feet at 7 seconds. Rough on the intracoastal waters. A chance of showers in the morning, then showers likely in the afternoon.
Northeast winds 20 to 25 knots. Seas 7 to 9 feet, occasionally to 11 feet. Wave detail: northeast 9 feet at 8 seconds. Rough on the intracoastal waters. Showers with a slight chance of thunderstorms.

Northeast winds 25 to 30 knots. Seas 9 to 11 feet, occasionally to 14 feet. Wave detail: northeast 11 feet at 9 seconds. Very rough on the intracoastal waters. Showers with a slight chance of thunderstorms.

Northeast winds 25 to 30 knots. Seas 10 to 12 feet, occasionally to 15 feet. Wave detail: northeast 12 feet at 9 seconds. Very rough on the intracoastal waters. Showers. A chance of thunderstorms in the evening, then a slight chance of thunderstorms after midnight.

Northeast winds 25 to 30 knots. Seas 10 to 12 feet, occasionally to 15 feet. Wave detail: northeast 11 feet at 9 seconds. Very rough on the intracoastal waters. Showers with a slight chance of thunderstorms.

East winds 20 to 25 knots. Seas 10 to 13 feet, occasionally to 17 feet. Rough on the intracoastal waters. Showers likely. A chance of thunderstorms in the evening, then a slight chance of thunderstorms after midnight.

East winds around 20 knots. Seas 10 to 12 feet, occasionally to 15 feet. Choppy on the intracoastal waters. Showers likely. A slight chance of thunderstorms in the morning, then a chance of thunderstorms in the afternoon.
East winds 15 to 20 knots. Seas 9 to 11 feet, occasionally to 14 feet. Choppy on the intracoastal waters. A chance of showers with a slight chance of thunderstorms.
South winds 10 to 15 knots, becoming southwest in the afternoon. Seas 7 to 9 feet, occasionally to 11 feet. A moderate chop on the intracoastal waters. A chance of showers.
Northwest winds around 10 knots. Seas calm. Mostly smooth on the intracoastal waters. A slight chance of showers in the evening.winds and waves higher in and near thunderstorms.
